name: Tabi Suru Majo to Owaranai Sekai -Orudamu Hen-
original_name: 旅する魔女と終わらない世界-オルダム編-
source:
This is the tale of Louise the witch, who is on a journey of certain intent.
She's accompanied by the young man Frey whose life she saved.
In a town where they stopped to rest, the two are involved in an incident-----

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE177535.html]DLsite English[/url]]
